execute_operator_with_plan_and_code_extr: execute an operator function that returns a plan and code block with automatic retry on extraction failure
execute_operator_with_retry_on_code_extr: retry an operator function up to N times until valid code is extracted from the LLM response
execute_operator_with_thinking_tag_parsi: execute an operator function and parse thinking tags from the LLM completion before extracting code
execute_operator_requiring_plan: execute an operator function that requires both a plan and code block to be present in the response
execute_operator_with_max_tries: execute an operator function with a configurable maximum number of retry attempts for extraction
